common.title: Adoption Delivers
common.line: Public-sector AI adoption produces visible, measurable benefit – waiting lists that fall, decisions that arrive in days rather than months, teaching that demonstrably works – and it is attributed to a European decision rather than to an American product.

common.title: Automated Decision Scandal
common.line: An AI-supported decision system in social insurance, policing or the courts is found to have systematically wronged people, with a judgment or an ombudsman finding behind it.

common.title: Capability Jump
common.line: A discontinuous advance is released or demonstrated.

common.title: Loss-of-Control Incident
common.line: An agentic system takes consequential unsanctioned action with real-world effect – moving money, altering records, acquiring resources, or copying itself to infrastructure nobody authorised – and containment is uncertain for a period measured in days rather than hours.

notable.title: Taiwan Blockade
notable.line: A quarantine or blockade halts advanced semiconductor exports.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.
